name: blueprint
description: Intent producer + invariant referee: design, spec, then hand implementation to any coding agent and verify the result. Generates design docs (RFC/ADR/etc.) that argue for an approach and agent-executable specs (interface contract, acceptance scenarios, Definition of Done), then referees the produced code against the spec — scenario coverage, an anti-vacuity thought-mutation check, Test Desiderata scoring, and quality flags, in a fresh-context evaluator. Tests remain the durable behavioral contract. Grounded in Kent Beck's Test Desiderata and Canon TDD principles.
